latency read off the trace:
  request -> wb_valid asserted       : 4000 ns = 2 cycles

What the trace cannot show: the real design splits vadd.vv
into micro-ops and the destination write-back competes with
other write ports; this model has one FU and one port, so the
cycle counts here are the model's, not measured Kunminghu
timing. They are quoted as 'the pipeline depth the model was
built to', and the design documents say so.
